column1: # The oldest Qt, KDE Frameworks and Git versions the application supports.
# CMakeLists.txt states the same floors as find_package versions, and each
# recipe as dependency versions. packaging/ci/baseline.sh checks every CI
# image against this table; tools/prepare-worktree.sh checks the host's Git.
# A package column that ends in .so names a library; the DEB image looks up
# the package that ships it, because the package names change with the ABI.
